notes.title: Brave Hand is OUT NOW on Steam! Replayable Card Game Fun
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/763340/Brave_Hand/]Brave Hand just launched[/url], and it’s now available on Steam! Brave Hand is my award-winning press-your-luck meets solitaire card game, and it's finally ready for you to play. It’s releasing for just $1.79 ($1.99 with a 10% launch discount), and includes achievements, leaderboards, and Steam Trading Cards. I’m excited for everyone to play and I hope the affordable price encourages you to check it out!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020424/5b70ede0c161d087e92befb67d677e69b319b47e.jpg[/img]

The game features 4 endlessly replayable modes, including a brand-new “Zen Mode.” In the game, you use the cards in your hand to challenge cards in 8 piles, and decide whether to press on challenging the same pile for exponential increase in points, or to stop and bank what you have. With randomized decks, pile complete bonuses, and special card rules to explore, you’ll find yourself playing over and over again. As you play, you unlock an epic story via 16 storybook pages. The pages double as customizable theme decks and backgrounds.

You can expect Brave Hand to be a small, highly-replayable, solitaire-style card game where your goal is to beat your previous score, and unlock a light story along the way. I made it because I loved the simple yet replayable games that came with my first computer, and wanted something like them, but with just a little more strategy.

If the main "Brave" mode is too hard or too random for your taste, you can try out the other modes! Boost Mode adds up to 3 legendary golden cards to your deck. The longer Jumbo Mode has 8 cards per pile and an epic 90 card deck. Finally, Zen Mode makes it easier to progress by letting you win ties and giving you more cards in your hand. Each mode is designed to cater to a specific type of playstyle and give you endless ways to play.

You can buy it from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/763340/Brave_Hand/]Steam store page[/url]. Feel free to contact me through Twitter, or our Discord if you run into any trouble or just want to follow along with development. I really hope you enjoy the game.

-Scott Brodie

notes.title: New "Easy Mode" Game Update
notes.content:
We're excited to release our first update in nearly 4 years to Hero Generations: ReGen! We're addressing one of our biggest player requests by adding a new, more forgiving play mode! [b]"Easy Mode"[/b] games have two rule changes. 
[olist]
[*] Clouds do not reset on new generations, letting you avoid having to scout the same tiles again. 
[*] Town improvements (buildings around towns) do not decay. 
[/olist]
Easy Mode offers a new way to play that lets you more easily make progress and explore all 6 biomes in a generated world. It also lets you more easily create some of the 20 town crafting upgrades. Give it a try and let us know how else we can improve this mode to fit your playstyle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25223977/d7c4d4e3065aa1531956570b9c62ee0764ca2d00.png[/img]

[h2]Call For Feedback And Reviews![/h2]
It's important to us that we address your feedback. If this update does that, we greatly appreciate you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/443260/Hero_Generations_ReGen/]giving the game a positive review[/url] on our store page, or updating your existing review to reflect this! Doing this helps us reach more players, and justify development time away from our new game in development, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042960/We_Are_The_Caretakers/]We Are The Caretakers[/url]. We would love to spend more time continuing to improve and add to the game!

[h2]Full Version 2.21 Change Log[/h2]
[list]
[*]New "Easy" Mode! Easy Mode games have two rule changes: Clouds do not reset on new generations, and town improvements (buildings) do not decay. A new way to play that lets you more easily make progress and explore all 6 biomes in a generated world.
[*]Mode Select option on new games. Choose Easy Mode or Basic Mode when starting a new game. Easy Mode save games will have a "present" icon on their entry.
[*]Bug fixes in menu flow that prevent blocking (quests, tech tree, etc) screens from overlapping.
[*]Special camera effects (Vintage and Black & White) are unlocked immediately for all players. Fixed bugs where players could not see camera effect settings and get stuck in a vfx mode.
[*]Upgraded the project to Unity version 2019.4, enabling bug fixes and easier future updates. Also gained some performance improvements in the process.
[*]Behind the scenes refactoring and adjustments to make debugging and updating easier.
[*]Extended the length of the upcoming Winter event (begins at the start of Dec)
[*]Heart Shaped Games Splash Screen added.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25223977/eda37bfbc1f5ca705a7031b3649959fd6d1fe9dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Event Update is Live! (V1.04)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25223977/eda37bfbc1f5ca705a7031b3649959fd6d1fe9dd.png[/img]

Halloween is almost upon us! We're celebrating with an early update to Hero Generations that features a special Halloween Event, as well a number of big changes that we've wanted to make for a long time. Be sure to restart Steam client to trigger the update. Here's the full change list!

[olist]
[*] [b]Halloween special event![/b] From now through November 1st, all worlds of Hero Generations will be overrun with pumpkins, skeletons, haunted forests, gravestones, candy, and more. Fire up a game and explore to find all of the fun fall changes!

[*] [b]New Building: Bank.[/b] The World Bank will be added to all newly created worlds. It allows players to deposit gold for future generations, plus interest. Explore your world to find it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25223977/9382321e7ed967771bd38c474bca188e4d1c4b01.png[/img]

[*] [b]New global quest:[/b] Craft a special town type.

[*] [b]High-Res Item Art:[/b] Added higher res images and changed all loot objects to have higher res images. No more grainy items in the UI.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25223977/7490bb06903a2332893c3b5cbe3a66a7d3f4b60e.png[/img]

[*] Added different sized icons to match the value of consumable items (strength potions, damage potions, lifespan potions, gravestones, and gold piles).

[*] Added camera focus event that tells player when the Fountain of Youth has refreshed with a new giant lifespan bonus.

[*] Added counter to Fountain of Youth description to help with long term tracking.

[*] Added world icons next to the titles on Quest pages in Quest UI.

[*] Enemies are now more likely to hold weapons and items, making combat more interesting and varied.

[*] Added ‘Block Holidays’ option in settings so players can avoid holiday modes if they would prefer.

[*] Increased initial player strength to 5 from 1.

[*] Added numeric icons on locks in tech tree UI so users know which generation buildings are unlocked in.

[*] Fixed visual glitch on Bone item when in item slot.

[*] Fixed Gravestones not giving gold after game load.

[*] Fixed Issues with Skipping the Tutorial.

[*] Fixed various minor bugs reported by the community.
[/olist]

Have fun and let us know what you think of the changes!

notes.title: ReGen October Update is live (v1.03 - New content, speed improvements, combat changes, bug fixes and more!)
notes.content:
Our latest Hero Generations: ReGen update is now live on Steam and will be coming shortly to our other platforms! This update includes a number of new additions to the game as well as changes that address common feedback we’ve received from players. Please let us know what you think!

[list]
[*]Combat sequence has been sped up (faster entry, faster exit, faster resolution animations).
[*]Heroes and enemy NPCs can achieve critical hits if their strength roll result is 50 or more above their opponent’s. Critical hits add 5 to damage. We spent some time looking for ways to make combat faster, more interesting, and less tedious later in the game. Critical hits reward you for building up your strength, and remove many repeat combat sequences later in the game when you have grown beyond most enemies in your world area.
[*]Sai, a new weapon that has a 25% chance of adding a +5 lifespan damage critical hit in combat.
[*]Raider, a new trait that enables hero to steal items from the enemy in combat.
[*]Gift of longevity now makes all cards in the mating flip game hold lifespan bonuses, if the item is held at the end of a generation.
[*]Added two special graphics modes (PC/Mac/Linux only due to performance impact on mobile): Black & White and Vintage. Modes can be toggled in settings and are unlocked by finishing (dying) games.
[*]Oracle now passes on wisdom about secrets in the game when it receives a letter.
[*]Improved clarity of deliver letter quest by highlighting the drop off destination with a cut scene.
[*]Clearing an Oasis has a different set of loot to drop, and is now more likely to give Keys.
[*]Gift shops now periodically have trait books for sale.
[*]Character items and traits now shown in save game slot.
[*]Fixed French language bug that caused crash after 2nd generation.
[*]Fixed crash bug with boss destroying barracks nodes.
[*]Fixed out of sync music bug.
[*]Fixed color animation text bug.
[*]Added new tip message about crafting towns for new players.
[*]Steam Achievement bugs should now be addressed.
[*]Reduced the size of the game package and reduced loading times.
[*]Minor improvements to translations across all supported languages based on feedback.
[*]Some objects in the game with low res sidebar portraits have been improved.
[/list]

Also, please remember that anyone that purchased the original [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/295590] Hero Generations [/url] has a 67% off coupon for ReGen in their inventory.

We’ll be releasing our next update roadmap soon. Let us know what you think of the update, and anything you’d love to see added to the game next!

notes.title: ReGen Update #1 is live (v1.02 - Bug Fixes, End Game Polish, PDF Art Book)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have just released our first update to Hero Generations: ReGen (v1.02)! Restart your Steam client to trigger the update. This update contains a number of minor bug fixes and gameplay enhancements.

[h1]v1.02 Full Change List[/h1]
[list]
    [*]A new camera Cutscene plays to highlight the end bosses' special attack. A new "toast" message with a clue also appears.
    [*]Highlight effects on mates could sometimes not appear when selecting them in towns.
    [*]All clear style quests (Oasis, Lairs, Sword In The Stone, etc) now behave as expected, and do not continue to give fame at the start of new generations while in the cleared state.
[*]Oasis quests in the Island world now clear individually, instead of when all Oasis nodes are cleared.
[*]Fixed situation where "Traits Full" option window would stay present past town screen.
[*]Added error catching for any save game loading issues. A message box appears with more info and instructions on how to report bugs.
[*]Removed debug command for toggling the UI on/off from production.
[*]World quests such as "Kill All Bosses" now track/reload properly. Existing save files will update to track existing progress.
[*]Special Events list for new generations save properly, so events that are chosen are consistent.
[*]Backend changes that should improve reliability of Steam achievements. For some players, this seems to fix the issue of many achievements unlocking at startup unexpectedly. Continuing to investigate the need for further fixes.
[/list]

[h1]PDF Art Book Free For All ReGen Owners![/h1]
On top of the above minor bug fixes, we've added a [b]36-page Art Book to the package for FREE ($5 value)![/b] It's a sort of behind-the-scenes look at the evolution of the Hero Generations art style. Previously a part of our HG1 special edition, we are now making it available as an added bonus for all Hero Generations: ReGen players. To find it, simply navigate to the game folder within the Steam directory on you computer, and it will be there after grabbing this update.

[h1]Thank You Coupons[/h1]
Finally, new 67% off coupons, that do not stack with other offers, should start dropping today for those HG1 owners who have not redeemed the previous launch coupon. You may also need to restart your Steam client for the new coupon to appear in your inventory.

Thanks, and we hope you enjoy the new changes!
